scope: A positive ideal thin lens and a concave spherical mirror facing the lens in homogeneous air. Mirror radius is a positive magnitude. Distances are measured from lens plane to mirror pole.
unitControl: Equivalent inputs 40 cm / 60 cm and 0.4 m / 0.6 m give the same physical placements up to input representation.
limits: Each optical length magnitude 1–10000 mm. Both possible positive mirror placements are reported, including a centre-retrace placement up to 20000 mm. Unknown finite object distance cannot be inferred from the source's collimated input.
